source.name: Cboe delayed quotes
source.note: Open interest is the exchange's latest published value; intraday volume is partial.

method.max_pain: For every listed strike, sum intrinsic payout at that settlement: calls OI x max(0, S-K) + puts OI x max(0, K-S), times 100. Minimum wins.
method.shelf: Strikes whose total payout is within 1% of the minimum.
method.one_sigma: Spot x ATM IV x sqrt(DTE / 365).
method.risk_reversal: 25-delta put IV minus 25-delta call IV, in volatility points.
method.gex: Black-Scholes gamma at each hypothetical spot x OI x 100 x S^2 x 0.01; calls positive, puts negative.
